note: What changed in each release, newest first, in plain words for learners. Drives the What's new card, the update notice, and Settings › About. Version numbers are MAJOR.MINOR.CONTENT.PATCH (docs/VERSIONING.md; three parts before 2.2.0.1); patches are listed only in Settings › About. The newest entry must match package.json (checked by tests).

releases.title: Shorter quick studies
highlights: A quick study is now three steps, about 10–15 minutes: the question, the heart of the answer, and a moment to reflect.
Want more? A deep study still has every step and the side questions, in about 25–35 minutes.
Partway through a quick study? You’ll pick up at your next step on the shorter path.

releases.title: Smoother studying
highlights: Only have a few minutes? Connect with Christ is now in the tab bar and on the home page, and you can stop an investigation after any step and pick up right where you left off.
New learners start at Easy, Gospel Labs remembers the level you choose, and “Continue anyway” is always there if a step has you stuck.
Shorter pages: a quick “you did it” at the end of an investigation, and Character of Christ shows the attributes first.
Answer choices are now shuffled, so the right answer isn’t always first.
What you write in a reflection, or in the private note on a Character of Christ page, now stays with its Discovery Card in your Notebook.
Fixed on phones: older research notebooks no longer push the Notebook past the edge of the screen, and activities, tabs, and step paths fit small screens.
Dates follow your own time zone, so something saved in the evening isn’t dated tomorrow.
Clearer wording, honest time estimates, smoother keyboard and screen-reader use, and your research notebooks from earlier versions are easier to find.

releases.title: A warmer welcome
highlights: New to Gospel Labs? A short welcome and tour help you get started, choose a look, and know where to report a problem.
After an update, a What’s new card shows what changed since your last visit.
Fixed: tapping anywhere on the Connect with Christ card on the home page now opens it.
Settings › About shows your version and every change since 1.0.

releases.title: A new way to study
highlights: A new home page: continue where you left off, or start studying in a tap or two, in a quick or a deep session.
Guided investigations of real gospel questions, with hands-on activities, four levels of difficulty, hints that point back to the scriptures, and side questions.
A Discovery Notebook and a personal Discovery Map that grow from what you study.
Scripture Explorer, Character of Christ, and Connect with Christ, a few quiet minutes with the Savior.
New themes and motion settings, and backups that include all of your study.
Your research notebooks are still in My Library, unchanged.

releases.title: Guided discovery
highlights: Research challenges, a discovery trail, and connections between pieces of evidence.
Save insights from any section, and an optional Come unto Christ reflection.
If Gospel Labs is open in two tabs, your edits are never silently overwritten.

releases.title: First release
highlights: A private research notebook for gospel questions: question, hypothesis, research, analysis, and conclusion.
A Question Bank, evidence cards, autosave, backups, and offline use.
